B adds an 'On this page' outline in its own region, and its sidebar lines up with the header's left edge; A indents its nav well in from the logo, which looks slightly off. Neither screenshot shows the phone layout, so item 5 can't be judged and both get a neutral 3. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): The two layouts are very similar: both have a labelled three-group sidebar with the current page highlighted, a prose column of comfortable width, and terminal-style code blocks that fit their commands. B separates its sidebar with a border but has no outline and leaves empty space on the right. Neither screenshot shows phone width, so item 5 can't be checked and both get a middling 3.
